erin: quick UX q — run-history rows get spammy when arg values dump full JSON. thinking a compact summary like 'object (3 keys)' with a small toggle to open a mini-json viewer. thoughts?

jo: yes please. hover is unreliable on mobile. toggle should be click/tap with aria-expanded and an accessible label: 'Open argument preview for <arg>'. keep visible label <= 12 chars.

sam: microcopy options for the toggle: "Preview", "Inspect", "Value". i prefer "Preview" (short + familiar). also suggest showing type + size inline, e.g. "object (3)" or "array (12)".

jo: accessibility: when expanded, move focus to the panel heading and announce: "Expanded argument preview for <arg>". Escape closes and returns focus to the toggle. do NOT trap focus. ensure chevron meets 4.5:1 contrast.

qa-bot: QA checklist added: keyboard open/close, screen reader announce, mobile tap target >=44px, virtualization regression test.

erin: UX/layout nit: avoid layout shifts. animate opacity + max-height only. pseudo CSS: `.panel{max-height:0;opacity:0}.panel.open{max-height:220px;opacity:1}`.

sam: copy variants to test in a quick A/B: ["Preview", "Show value", "Inspect"]. localization note: avoid punctuation and verbs implying network fetch.

design-bot: Created PL-3309 "Run-history: compact arg summary + toggle" https://go/redwood/PL-3309

erin: next steps: sam add copy variants to PL-3309, jo add a11y checklist, i'll prototype the mini-json compact view. sync 20m. :thumbsup:
